name: Jade Wellua
source:
A noble from a small aristocratic family, the Crowlds. He has quite a huge influence within the castle due to his family's reputation. He stays in the largest room among the lower floors of the castle. Born into an artist family, he has genius painting skills. He is moody in nature.

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bride-of-the-twilight/id1598260899]English App Store[/url]]
